fresh_sources.task13: Notion TASK-13 Component Sheet & Image Production Contract

coverage.delete_test: Removing the approved logo direction weakens project identity but does not block the core loop.
coverage.consequence_if_missing: Brand drift and inconsistent future key art.
coverage.note: Vector/store production remains a later separate asset-production gate.

coverage.purpose: Shared readable frame, badges, semantic state presentation
coverage.existing_asset_or_reference: Component Sheets A-D + semantic UI pack / PR #151 merged
coverage.delete_test: Removing it forces duplicated per-screen UI and increases inconsistency and maintenance cost.
coverage.consequence_if_missing: State inconsistency, duplicated art, weaker mobile readability.
coverage.note: Component-level automated evidence exists; full product-screen and human/device evidence do not.

coverage.purpose: Conversation, investigation framing, and character-choice readability
coverage.delete_test: A text-only fallback could function, but the approved half-body composition is important to character attachment and scene readability.
coverage.consequence_if_missing: Weaker character connection and visual continuity.
coverage.note: Layout direction is approved; final character/background runtime assets remain separate.

coverage.purpose: Make direct glyph input, recognition/retry, and source ownership understandable
coverage.existing_asset_or_reference: Task6 + Task9 merged implementation, six approved runtime glyph PNGs, and semantic UI pack
coverage.delete_test: Without a clear drawing state the game's direct-writing promise is not understandable.
coverage.consequence_if_missing: Core fantasy and input recovery become opaque.
coverage.note: Task9 Product Root consumes the six-glyph resolver path. New glyph generation is not a current gap; human small-size readability remains unverified.

coverage.purpose: Show that Stock is a typed glyph placement source, not a completed spell
coverage.existing_asset_or_reference: GM-SPELL-WORKFLOW-UI-V2-01 + current Stock canon + semantic UI components
coverage.delete_test: If this distinction is visually weak, players can misunderstand Stock as auto-spell storage.
coverage.consequence_if_missing: Core resource semantics and player planning are misread.
coverage.note: Task9 carries the source-selection flow. Preserve semantic redundancy; human comprehension validation remains pending.

coverage.purpose: Explain center main glyph + 0-5 equivalent auxiliary vertices, source reservation, circuit preview, and PreparedSpell creation
coverage.existing_asset_or_reference: Task7 merged implementation; existing generated battle/spell image is REWORK_REQUIRED for system UI
coverage.delete_test: Without a representative Stage2 composition, the central spell-design differentiator remains visually ambiguous.
coverage.consequence_if_missing: The product can look like a generic spell menu rather than direct semantic circuit design.
coverage.note: Task9 Product Root now presents the merged circuit path. A representative sheet is not a runtime asset and is not a current production requirement.

coverage.purpose: Show explicit target keyword, final expected result/risk preview, Mana spend, and explicit use
coverage.existing_asset_or_reference: Task8 recovery implementation is merged through Task9 Product Root on current main
coverage.delete_test: Final use must remain explicit and understandable, but a final visual should not outrun the missing current Task8 product screen.
coverage.consequence_if_missing: Commit risk/cost can become opaque; generating too early can create rework against the eventual consumer.
coverage.note: The explicit target and two-step cast flow exists in Task9. It still requires human, device, and performance evidence.

coverage.purpose: Anchor Frostbloom greenhouse location, readable hazards, and before/after world state
coverage.existing_asset_or_reference: Approved references plus three persisted IMG-02 source candidates; none is bound by a current-main Godot scene
coverage.delete_test: Generic backgrounds would preserve mechanics but erase place identity and weaken cause/effect readability.
coverage.consequence_if_missing: Weak world memory and unclear environmental consequences.
coverage.note: Source candidates are not runtime exports or scene consumers. Keep them unbound until a concrete Godot scene and Texture binding are merged.

coverage.purpose: Support dialogue attachment and distinct viewpoints in the Frostbloom incident
coverage.existing_asset_or_reference: Anime half-body style direction approved; generated names/costumes are explicitly noncanonical
coverage.delete_test: Silhouette-only placeholders can run, but the intended character-driven magic-school experience is materially weakened.
coverage.consequence_if_missing: Characters become answer-delivery UI instead of remembered people.
coverage.note: Use only characters confirmed by current world/narrative canon; do not infer generated reference identities.

coverage.purpose: Maintain companion attachment and support-role continuity
coverage.existing_asset_or_reference: ART-STYLE-01 companion direction + earlier approved checkpoint continuity
coverage.delete_test: The first-session mechanics can run without bespoke companion art, but the long-term school/companion fantasy loses a major identity anchor.
coverage.consequence_if_missing: Reduced attachment and weaker visual continuity across field/battle/result.
coverage.note: Initial form only for Slice; long-term growth forms remain deferred.

coverage.purpose: Give the incident a readable single focal threat/state source
coverage.delete_test: A placeholder can test logic, but a Vertical Slice cannot communicate threat, instability, and resolution quality without a readable focal entity.
coverage.consequence_if_missing: Combat/crisis becomes abstract and environmental change is harder to read.
coverage.note: One strong reusable set; do not expand to waves or multiple enemy families for the Slice.

coverage.existing_asset_or_reference: Star UI Kit vectors + semantic UI pack + blue/purple magic direction
coverage.delete_test: Removing state feedback makes system causality and error responsibility hard to understand.
coverage.consequence_if_missing: Players cannot reliably tell what changed or why.
coverage.note: Critical states require shape/icon/text redundancy, not color-only cues.

coverage.purpose: Turn outcome, cost, side effect, discovery, and player reasoning into retained knowledge
coverage.existing_asset_or_reference: Approved checkpoint Result Return direction + current Grimoire canon
coverage.delete_test: Without visible record/recap, the learning loop ends at spectacle instead of becoming knowledge for the next problem.
coverage.note: Prefer reusable live UI and result card components over screen-specific baked full-frame art.

coverage.purpose: Move between school/greenhouse scene contexts without implying 3D exploration scope
coverage.delete_test: A direct scene transition can satisfy the flow; a dedicated exploration art set is not required for the current Slice.
coverage.consequence_if_missing: Only minor presentation loss if transitions remain clear.
coverage.note: CUT_NEW_3D_EXPLORATION_ASSET. Reuse scene backgrounds/map cards/transitions rather than creating a separate 3D movement asset family.

coverage.purpose: Maintain Korean-first readability and licensed reusable interface symbols
coverage.existing_asset_or_reference: Asset Spec requires licensed fonts; semantic icons/components partly exist
coverage.delete_test: Default engine text can prototype but cannot close a shipping-intent visual slice or localization readability gate.
coverage.note: Rights/provenance and Korean runtime font validation remain separate evidence gates.

coverage.purpose: Store first impression after playable proof
coverage.existing_asset_or_reference: Logo/visual direction can seed later key art
coverage.delete_test: Not needed to validate the current first-session visual workflow.
coverage.note: Recheck current platform/store specifications at release time.

coverage.existing_asset_or_reference: Current live-UI boundary forbids generated functional text/numbers as authority
coverage.delete_test: Removing baked functional text improves localization and correctness.
coverage.note: Keep functional labels, values, Mana, success rate, state truth, and localization as live UI.

alternatives.tradeoff: Task6 implementation and existing direction already cover this better than the current Stage2 gap.

alternatives.brief: Typed Glyph Vault/Stock -> FIVE_POINT_STAR -> Prepared Spell
alternatives.benefit: Closes the exact Stock/circuit semantic misunderstanding identified in the approved representative-screen rework boundary.
alternatives.tradeoff: Must avoid inventing Stage3 target/use behavior.

alternatives.brief: Prepared Spell -> Target -> Final Preview -> Use
alternatives.benefit: Shows the final explicit decision and cost/risk commitment.
alternatives.tradeoff: Task8 product screen is not on current main, so a final visual now has higher rework risk.

next_single_visual_choice.selection_reason: Task9 now covers the glyph, circuit, target, and cast runtime flow. No new image has a current-main consumer gap.

next_single_visual_text_brief.goal: 한 화면에서 '보관된 글자/Stock을 재료로 선택하고, FIVE_POINT_STAR 회로에 배치해 Prepared Spell을 만드는 과정'을 즉시 이해시키는 대표 시안.
next_single_visual_text_brief.player_question: 내가 가진 글자를 어디서 가져와 어떻게 회로에 배치하고, 언제 주문이 준비 상태가 되는가?
composition: LEFT_SOURCE_RAIL: exact Vault와 typed Glyph Stock을 서로 다른 출처로 명확히 구분
CENTER_MAIN_FOCUS: FIVE_POINT_STAR 회로, 중앙 Main 1개 + 동일 위상의 외곽 보조 0~5
RIGHT_PREPARED_SUMMARY: 회로 Preview와 Prepared Spell 상태만 보여주고 Target/Use는 아직 진입하지 않음
SCENE_CONTEXT_REMAINS_VISIBLE: 온실/사건 맥락이 UI 뒤에서 완전히 사라지지 않음
next_single_visual_text_brief.visual_style: Logo 01 + Magic/Anime overlay on Soft Storybook Cel 2D Hybrid; navy/gold frame; blue-purple magic glow; clean anime character over storybook greenhouse environment.
next_single_visual_text_brief.text_policy: Functional numbers, success rate, Mana, target names, arbitrary dialogue, and final button copy are not baked into the image. If section labels are necessary, use only minimal canonical Korean concept labels such as '보관 글자', '주문 회로', '준비 주문'.
must_not: completed-spell inventory cards pretending to be Stock
arbitrary character canon, names, dialogue, costs, success percentages, Mana values

google_sheets_migration_note: Legacy Sheet visual inventory was used only to recover unique historical categories/caps. This file and Notion Visual Bible are the current structured/human coverage owners; no new Sheet canon write is authorized.
